name: Somatropin
description: Recombinant human growth hormone, identical in sequence to pituitary somatotropin. Approved for growth hormone deficiency in children and adults and for several specific growth disorders.

systems.note: Replaces the pituitary somatotropic output; placed by intended effect on the GH axis.
Anabolic effect on lean soft tissue is a labelled and intended outcome.
Growth hormone antagonises insulin action; glucose intolerance is labelled.
IGF-1 is produced hepatically and transaminase movement is reported.

monitors.why: The stable downstream index of GH exposure and the standard titration marker.
Read with IGF-1 to interpret the free fraction under GH replacement.
Interval tracking of GH-induced insulin resistance.
Growth hormone alters peripheral thyroid hormone conversion.
